ja.html: 獅子吼「――楽翁陣らくおうじん！」
ja.text: 獅子吼「――楽翁陣らくおうじん！」

en.html:
RakoujinYou called, sir?
ShishikuSituation first. What is the state of His Highness Kuniuji's protection?
RakoujinThree armored warriors of his personal retinue appear to be guarding him.
ShishikuThree... And with that I am supposed to feel secure. I shall take Nabuse and go myself.
ShishikuSend one of your units round the rear to prepare an escape as well. If the situation does not improve satisfactorily, His Highness must first withdraw from the mansion.
RakoujinSo few enemies, and our lord must be moved. The humiliation is considerable, sir.
ShishikuThen one more apology is pending. Once the great ambition is fulfilled, I can cut open my belly for this also. Bas. His Highness's life cannot be the price of my dignity.
RakoujinAs you command. And ourselves?
ShishikuKanae is following me. Kill her.
Rakoujin—
ShishikuOrdinary soldiers? Useless lot. Say Kanae's name, just those three characters, and their knees resign from service...
ShishikuTen years, it seems, have done nothing to remove their dread of the disinherited princess.
RakoujinIt is as one might expect.
ShishikuYou fellows will not give me the same tamasha, I trust?
RakoujinOur fear of the princess is no less. Only, from the beginning, we have been stones for throwing away.
RakoujinNothing remains that we need to hold on to. Her life we shall take, even if our own must go with it.
ShishikuGood. Go!
RakoujinYes, sir!

ja.html:
楽翁陣「お召しの儀は」
獅子吼「まず現状だ。 　邦氏殿下のご身辺はどうなっている？」
楽翁陣「近習の武者三騎が固めておる様子」
獅子吼「三騎……心許ない。 　ならばそちらには俺が銘伏なぶせを連れて向かう」
獅子吼「陣の一組を裏へ回して、脱出の手筈も整え させておけ。 　状勢の回復が思わしからぬようであれば、 殿下にはひとまず屋敷からご避難頂く」
楽翁陣「小勢に追われて主君を動かすと仰せか。 　恥辱でござるな」
獅子吼「大望成った後、我が腹を捌いて詫びるべき 事柄がまた一つ増えるというだけの話だ。 　殿下の御身には代えられん」
楽翁陣「御意。 　して、我らは？」
獅子吼「俺の後を香奈枝が追っている。 　殺せ」
楽翁陣「――」
獅子吼「尋常の兵どもでは当てにならん。 　あやつらは香奈枝の三字を耳にするだけで 腰が砕ける……」
獅子吼「廃嫡姫への畏怖は十年の時を経ても拭われ なかったらしい」
楽翁陣「さもあろうかと」
獅子吼「貴様らはよもや醜態を見せまいな？」
楽翁陣「あの姫を恐るるは我らとて同じ。 　されど我らは元より捨石の者」
楽翁陣「惜しむべき何物もござらねば、差し違えに 挑んで討ち果たし申そう」
獅子吼「良し。行け！」
楽翁陣「はッ」
